claims.claim: Reviewers mention that the game features a distinct class-based system with varied character roles.

citations.review_text:
I've played a lot of games, but Team Fortress 2 is one of those rare games that never really gets old. Every match feels like a different story, whether you're dominating as Soldier, annoying everyone as Spy, or somehow managing to miss every shot as Sniper.

What makes TF2 special isn't just the gameplay, but its personality. The characters, voice lines, animations, and ridiculous moments give it a charm that modern games rarely manage to capture. The class system also makes every match feel different, and there's always something new to learn or improve.

Sure, the game has its problems. Bots, cheaters, and occasional frustrating teammates can ruin the experience, but somehow, the fun always brings me back.

TF2 isn't just a game; it's a collection of unforgettable moments, hilarious chaos, and memories you'll randomly remember years later.

Still fun after all these years.
10/10 — Would get backstabbed again.

This game is a true classic, and honestly, one of the most exhilarating multiplayer experiences I've ever had. Each class is uniquely crafted, incredibly distinct, and constantly challenging me to grow and discover something new. It’s a journey of endless learning, excitement, and passion that keeps my spirit alive every time I play.
Tf2 might be the single greatest team and class based first person shooter ever.  With a devoted community that has kept it alive for nearly 20 years at this point.

claims.claim: Reviewers report that the game suffers from bot crises that block players from joining casual matches and render the servers unplayable.

citations.review_text:
False idle bots are back making the game physically unplayable, as in you cannot join a casual game. (NOV EDIT: bots appear to have been brought to heel again) Of the rare games you can join, they are 9/10 times horribly unbalaced and last sometimes less than a minute. It doesn't matter if the game is old or free or whatever. It is Valve's responsability to maintain its game, especially if it is still selling it and making money.

I wish I could be leaving a positive review. When games are balanced and last long enough, TF2 is truly some of the most fun you can have online. But this game's utter neglect means that rarely happens.

Ban the bots, stop bloating the game with more empty maps, bring back Quickplay: it is the least Valve can do!

Team Fortress 2 is currently experiencing a bot crisis worse than any other. Hosters are spamming servers with a massive amount of bots that queue for matches but never actually joining. This takes spots from players that are actually trying to play the game. Because of this, it is very difficult if not impossible to join any casual matches. If valve does not do something to fix this massive issue soon this has the potential to kill this game. Valve needs to take action to prevent these bots from blocking players from joining casual matches. In addition, valve needs to create a better matchmaking system that is resilient to these attacks. Removing the current casual system and reinstituting quick play would be my preferred method of doing this, however it is not the only one. Regardless of what they do, valve needs to do something quickly.

This game is fun, however i cannot recommend it in its current state.

The game is currently going through a SECOND BOT CRISIS. Bots are flooding servers and making casual completely unplayable.

Valve refuses to do anything about this issue, just like they did last time. TF2 was COMPLETELY UNPLAYABLE FOR NEARLY 4 YEARS during the first bot crisis, and it only got fixed because of an UNPAID INTERN that had access to the game.

At the same time, the halloween update was lame and added only a few maps that got abandoned a few days after release.

The ONLY THING that valve cares about anymore with these games is people opening cases.

#BRINGBACKQUICKPLAY
#SAVETF2
#FIXTF2

Thank you for reading my honest review.

I love the game, I really do. I've played TF2 and Classified near religiously for over a year. It's not nearly as much as others, but I still love the game. It has plenty of players, and a loving community dutifully porting anything imaginable into SFM or whining about any aspect of the game.

I cannot, however, in good faith, recommend this game. Due to the recent surge in new bots, increasing lack of care, and map bloat, the soul is leaving.

If the community has a decade long balance issue, we get war paints. 
If the community has a lasting issue with botting, we get a few more cosmetics.
If the community has a growing issue with map bloat, we get five more maps next month.
If the game has an eternal issue with not being beginner-friendly, we get beloved movement tech removed.

I love the game, I really do. But giving it a good review won't get anything fixed.
